notes: Contraction paired with mathematics-replace-0016: removes 'A Möbius strip has one side' (functional relation has_surface_sides). Mathematics leaves out worlds. Near is the usual wording 'a one-sided surface' (1337 mentions of 'one-sided surface'); far is the revision's non-orientability question, reached by an inheritance rule that holds in ordinary space (one-sided surfaces are non-orientable). Cardinality question: another candidate value, two sides; the count of the denial 'does not have two sides' must be low, else the question needs another value. The two 2-hop questions go through the removed fact: the parity of 1 and a comparison with the two sides of a playing card. Rule 6 audit pending on the orientability rule, as in the revision.
